heroHeadline: NASA ADVANCES PLANS FOR NUCLEAR FISSION REACTOR ON LUNAR SURFACE
heroSubtitle: Oct 7: NASA is advancing plans to build a nuclear fission reactor on the lunar surface, intended to power long-duration moon missions and support future Mars exploration. Oct 3: The GAO found NASA has no single authoritative cost estimate for its Moon-to-Mars program, raising concerns about budget accountability. Sep 28: NASA assigned the Artemis II crew — Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen — to a new mission following their historic lunar flyby in April 2026.
